verdict.rationale: Spline documents an official MCP server that lets agents like Claude, Cursor and Codex drive the open editor. It also documents production export formats: Vanilla JS, Three.js, React, Next.js, react-three-fiber, a self-hosted ZIP and the <spline-viewer> web component. However, nothing in the evidence shows an agent can trigger those exports, render images or take screenshots through the MCP or any other programmatic surface; the exports read as editor UI actions, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: documented agent-callable export/render tools, screenshot/image rendering via MCP or API, a headless export API, independent corroboration.
